name: jetski-race
note: the race from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host, on a water with a wave mask; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-beach
note: beached on the sand, nose inland, throttle and stick: the craft drives back to the water in about 3 s (it spun on the spot, 8 s and no metres, before); control: no throttle does not count as driving off

name: jetski-handling
note: the handling, by real input on a software GL: a tighter carve when leaning back, a price for over-steering, the rider working, landings that matter, the course area; each with its own comparison

name: jetski-menu
note: the menus by real input, pad and keyboard: every page and back, pause with restart and quit, championship points, a time trial alone; controls: nothing finished pays nothing, a championship keeps its rivals

name: jetski-sound
note: Cold Sound from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host, on the second course; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-ramps
note: the ramps stand: no pile's foot over the water, the low end always under, the top always clear, at the biggest sea of every difficulty on both courses and both ends of Cold Sound's tide (control: lifted 60 m); the same jump at any moment of the sea (control: decks that tip); computer riders take them, land them and lose no more than 5 points of buoys (control: no one goes for a ramp)

name: jetski-placed
note: everything placed by hand stands on something: a building's whole foot on the ground, what stands in the sea under its lowest water; control: lifted 0.6 m. It failed on 40 of Iron Quay's cranes, lamps and containers hung over the quay's edge

name: jetski-buoys
note: the next buoy from the race camera at 100 m and 150 m on every course, GL and WebGPU on the cart: its height, area and contrast from pictures of one held moment with and without it. Control: the small buoy this replaced must fail

name: jetski-ramp-reach
note: every ramp can be reached from the buoy before it and still make the next buoy on its right side, by the real handling at race speed on the course's biggest sea at Hard. Control: the same ramp moved 90 m aside must fail

name: jetski-races
note: a whole race on every course, nobody stuck, rivals missing no more buoys than recorded; control: a race cut short has not been run

name: jetski-landing-fair
note: riding the water does not punish you: a whole race on the biggest sea on every course, the median landing keeps its speed, few under 0.9. Control: fair 0; a nose dive still costs

name: jetski-feel
note: the race answers: every event on two channels, a turbo that pays, a pack that stays together, a place that does not flicker, a crash that is a crash; each with its control

name: jetski-minimap
note: the minimap tells the truth and stays small, on the cart, GL and WebGPU. Controls: dots 60 m off, three times the size

name: jetski-refraction
note: nothing lit reaches the water's refraction: lime pixels on the sea in a championship race, GL and WebGPU on the cart. Control: v0.14.0, whose marks came through the wakes as lime patches on WebGPU, must fail

name: jetski-ram
note: a hard hit from another craft can put a rider down, a rub never does, and whole races stay races. Control: ram 0

name: jetski-cam-cut
note: from one race to the next through the results page, no frame drawn with the camera under the sea. Control: the old first frame, drawn from a zeroed place

name: jetski-quality
note: a program for everything drawn at every quality on both courses and backends

name: jetski-canyon
note: Red Reach from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-harbour
note: Iron Quay from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-storm
note: Gale Bank from the grid, computer riders: every racer's position bits on every host; control: a bigger sea must change them

name: jetski-cliff-structure
note: a rock wall from a distance has big shapes as well as fine grain: 24 to 96 px contrast against under 5 px, on rock pixels, from held cameras, GL and WebGPU on the cart. A tile of the picture repeated over the wall must read low; the cart before the rock faces (run with --expect-low) measures under the floor. Say nothing of beauty: look at the pictures

name: jetski-bigramp
note: the big ramps and the ways down, by real input on a software GL: every big ramp gives far more air than a normal one and lands clean, back and front flips land, the kick button kicks, nose down along the line goes under, tail first and straight down are wipeouts. Controls: a normal ramp fails the air bound, dive 0 does not go under, no button no trick

name: jetski-air
note: the air by the pad on the cart, GL and WebGPU, in ranged requests (the game keeps each flight's measures in its fly.* debug fields: the tick it started, its lowest point, the furthest foot, the first trick's turn; the stick is timed from the flight's first tick): a big ramp gives 1.25 times the air of a normal one, a back flip turns the pitch one whole turn up and over and a front flip one whole turn nose first and both land, the kick puts a foot out to the side, nose down goes under and comes back up with no wipeout off big and normal ramps, tail first is a wipeout. Controls: the normal ramp against the big one, a barrel roll turns no pitch, no press keeps the foot in its well, dive 0 stays on top

name: jetski-trick-mash
note: a newcomer mashing the trick button through a lap of Crater Atoll on its biggest sea at Hard, the computer steering: no wipeout from a trick, a press on a hop too short for one is a style move; a ramp still takes a full trick under the same mashing. Control: trick_guard 0 comes down mid-trick

name: jetski-finish
note: the two ends of a race on the CPU: the throttle down in the last beat of the countdown is a rocket start and ahead off the line (control: held from the first beat, a plain start); over the line the results wait at least 2.5 s while the rivals race on, and every rival has a time (control: finish_hold 0 puts them up at once)

name: jetski-sound-life
note: a minute of racing starts at least 90 sounds (55 before) (hull slaps, tricks, buoys, places); every course plays its own loop; the nearest rivals engines are placed in the world. Control: audio_old 1, only the sounds before this pass, falls short

name: jetski-newcomer
note: a first race on the cart by the pad and the screen alone, GL and WebGPU: A starts the race and the rider steers past each mark on the side its chevron points to, with a 0.3 s reaction delay, a wandering aim error and now and then a turn held too long, passing the marks in 45 s with at most one missed. Control: the d-pad never touched does not race the marks

name: jetski-near
note: speed you can see: in the first minute of a race on every course the floats strung out from the marks bring at least 20 of them within 15 m of the player (native, software GL). Control: sw floats 0 brings none

name: jetski-flash
note: a rocket start, a turbo at top speed and the finish into the results, frame by frame on the cart: no ninth of the screen flashes more than twice in any second (WCAG 2.3.1 allows 3). Control: a quarter of the screen blinking at 5 Hz is caught

name: jetski-hud-words
note: words on the race screen on the cart, GL and WebGPU, in ranged requests (the game counts the frames the distance meets a word, hud.label_hits, and keeps the words put up, hud.pops and hud.pop_tick): restarting from the pause menu or starting a new race leaves no word from the last one, and the distance to the next buoy never meets a word in countdowns, wipeouts and big ramps on every course. Controls: pop_keep 1 keeps the word (a build without the reset failed the same way), label_old 1 meets words in the same rides

name: jetski-standup
note: the two craft on the cart, GL and WebGPU, one input timeline a run: from rest on open calm water the stand-up is slower on the straight, planes later and turns far tighter, and only it does a submarine and a pole stand (with a rumble each); half a minute on the biggest sea keeps every boot on the tray and glove on its grip, the hull on the water and the chase camera free of shake. Controls: a run that never set the craft shows none of the differences, hips lifted 0.4 m, ride_top 0, cam_jitter 1. With --baseline (main's jetski_auto cart) the sit-down races to the same bits as before

name: jetski-craft-models
note: the craft models from their files: the sit-down's bow a raked beak (keel and sheer rising and convex, no dip in the foredeck, stem 20 to 30 deg), the stand-up's hood 0.45 m over its tray and its hull 0.3 m deep. Controls: the first sit-down bow and the first stand-up hull

name: jetski-weather
note: the weather, on the cart through romdev, GL and WebGPU, one timeline a run: the wave height rises calm, choppy, storm; each course's weather route open in one weather and shut in another; the computer riders take an open route and keep off a shut one and off rocks a calm shows; the big water event's waves reach every racer; stunt mode scores a combo; a wrong-side mark empties the turbo on screen; repeated misses are not nagged; the rider holds on through a storm race; the championship's pace ramps by small steps; the weather's rocks and slabs stand on the bed. Each with its control

name: jetski-weather-perf
note: what the weather costs the GPU, through romdev frame({op:'timing'}): calm, storm and the big waves within 10 % (and 0.6 ms) of each course in its usual weather, GL and WebGPU. Control: 2 ms more must fail

name: jetski-water
note: see-through water: on the cart through romdev, GL and WebGPU, both craft, day, dusk and night, the sim held still. A self-lit plate 0.1 to 1.2 m under the surface and the craft lowered by the same: what shows through just under the surface and fades with depth faster than the plain water, weaker at night and dusk. Controls: the plain water (see_through 0) does not fade like that; night with see_night 1 is not weak; the held moment is held

name: jetski-water-ramp
note: a ramp deck under the water shows no shoal foam band: bright foam pixels from a held camera above the deck low end, GL and WebGPU. Control: the cart of v0.12.3, whose decks were in the refraction, shows several times as many
